<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['N', 'W']:
        print(f"Player/trail: {n['color']} at {n['boundary']}, pixels={n['pixels']}")
    elif n['color'] == 'b':
        print(f"Blue: {n['boundary']}, pixels={n['pixels']}")

# Check player position after LEFT

curr_seg = current_frame.segmentation

    if n['color'] == 'N':
        prev_player = n['boundary']
        break
for n in curr_seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        curr_player = n['boundary']
        break

if prev_player and curr_player:
    row_before = (prev_player[0][0] + prev_player[2][0]) // 2
    col_before = (prev_player[0][1] + prev_player[2][1]) // 2
    row_after = (curr_player[0][0] + curr_player[2][0]) // 2
    col_after = (curr_player[0][1] + curr_player[2][1]) // 2
    print(f"Player center: ({row_before}, {col_before}) -> ({row_after}, {col_after})")
    print(f"Movement: row {row_after-row_before:+d}, col {col_after-col_before:+d}")

# Player at row 37, col 37 (after LEFT from col 41)
# Bottom blue box at row 37-38, col 33-34
# Player is adjacent to the blue box!
# Let me try LEFT again to see if the player can move onto/collect the blue box
print("\nTrying LEFT to move onto blue box")
action(['LEFT'])
